latest_release.name: v2.15.1
latest_release.body:
## Changes

- fix: stop matching the Bing app as Google Search @bardrop (#647)
- fix: detect UC Browser from UCMobile, UCPC and UBrowser tokens @bardrop (#648)
- docs: fix dead docs page link in README @farisbasha (#649)
- feat: detect Bertina Browser @abertina (#651)
- fix: report Chrome OS as desktop @lagudafuadtosin (#645)
- feat: detect the Freebox Revolution browser @copilot-swe-agent (#646)
- fix: report Blink for Edge on Android and WebKit for Edge on iOS @lagudafuadtosin (#637)
- fix: fall back to the Chrome/ version for Chromium builds without one @lagudafuadtosin (#640)
- fix: read the UC Browser version from UCBrowser/ before Version/ @lagudafuadtosin (#638)
- fix: read the real iOS version on iOS 26, where the UA OS version is … @lagudafuadtosin (#636)
- fix(types): allow undefined from compareVersion @Hugohong258 (#641)
- fix: stop the Opera version at the last number @lagudafuadtosin (#639)
- fix(ci): publish on Node 24 with npm pinned to 11.x @lancedikson (#643)
